age.evidence: C57BL/6J mice were received from Jackson Laboratory (Bar Harbor, ME, USA) at 8 weeks of age and were acclimated for 1-2 weeks

sex.evidence: Each drug was tested using groups of 12 mice per sex (i.e., 24 total mice per drug).

dosing.evidence: DOI, psilocybin, and LSD were dissolved in 0.9% saline and administered subcutaneously (s.c.)... Dose ranges for each drug were 0.03-10 mg/kg for DOI
Dose ranges for each drug were... 0.003-1 mg/kg for LSD
Dose ranges for each drug were... 0.03-10 mg/kg for psilocybin

handling.evidence: At 1-2 weeks prior to the beginning of experiments, mice were habituated to handling and receiving s.c. saline injections.

group_housing.evidence: Mice were initially group housed 4 per cage during acclimation... Mice were single housed post-implant, and for the duration of the experiments

day_night_flipped.evidence: Experiments were conducted during the light phase (1300-1700 local time; lights on = 0700 in a 12/12 light/dark cycle).

assays.assay_description: 30-min session in TruScan locomotor arenas with cylindrical inserts and transparent flooring after s.c. drug injection; HTRs scored from overhead video (120 fps) using CleverSys software. Doses: DOI 0.03-10 mg/kg, LSD 0.003-1 mg/kg, psilocybin 0.03-10 mg/kg, in male and female mice.

application_type.evidence: administered subcutaneously (s.c.) in an injection volume of 0.01 mL/g body weight

setup_habituation.evidence: Mice were then placed into experimental chambers for acclimation. After 5 min of acclimation, basal body temperature was recorded followed by s.c. injection

setup_restrain.evidence: mice were returned to test chambers for 30 min (freely moving in TruScan arenas)

food_restriction.evidence: Food and water were available ad libitum (in home cage); no food in testing apparatus during 30 min session

water_restriction.evidence: Food and water were available ad libitum (in home cage); no water in testing apparatus during 30 min session

time_to_assay.evidence: followed by s.c. injection of drug or vehicle, and mice were returned to test chambers for 30 min.

sample_size.evidence: Each drug was tested using groups of 12 mice per sex (i.e., 24 total mice per drug)... Fig. 2... DOI (n = 5-7), LSD (n = 6), and psilocybin (n = 5-6)

outcomes.summary: DOI, LSD, and psilocybin produced dose-related increases in HTR counts in both sexes, with similar potencies between males and females. Females exhibited significantly greater maximal HTR counts at high doses across all three drugs (DOI 10 mg/kg, LSD 1 mg/kg, psilocybin 3 mg/kg).
outcomes.statistics: LSD dose×sex F(6,71)=2.631, p=0.0232; psilocybin dose×sex F(6,62)=2.683, p=0.0222; DOI dose×sex F(6,72)=2.083, p=0.0657; post-hoc DOI 10 mg/kg p=0.0017, LSD 1 mg/kg p=0.0368, psilocybin 3 mg/kg p=0.0042; Emax DOI F(1,80)=8.450, p=0.0047; Emax LSD F(1,67)=8.385, p=0.0051
outcomes.evidence: females uniformly displayed more HTRs at high doses administered across chemotypes... significant dose x sex interactions were observed for LSD and psilocybin

B1_num_measures.evidence: HTR counts were the only behavioural variable analysed in this assay

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: The time-course for the effects of the compounds on HTR were similar between sexes, with DOI (Fig. 3A-B), LSD (Fig. 3C-D), and psilocybin (Fig. 3E-F) showing peak effects within 5-10 min post drug administration.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of transitions, sequences, or bout structure

B4_ethological.evidence: HTR is explicitly excluded as an ethological behaviour per rubric

B6_cognitive.evidence: HTR does not require learning or memory

B7_automated_classification.evidence: analyzed using a commercially available software package from Clever Sys Inc. (CleverSys TopScan is on SCORE-0 list)

E1_environment_type.evidence: TruScan mouse locomotor arenas equipped with photobeam arrays

E2_shelter.evidence: cylindrical inserts with transparent flooring; no shelter

E3_bedding.evidence: transparent flooring to aid in semi-automated HTR detection

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material in testing apparatus

E6_spatial.evidence: TruScan arena with cylindrical insert = single chamber

E8_food_water.evidence: No food/water in testing chamber during 30 min session

D1_continuity.evidence: Each mouse was recorded for one 30-min session per dose; data across doses are independent dose-response observations, not multiple sessions for the same condition

D2_session_duration.evidence: mice were returned to test chambers for 30 min

D3_recording_days.evidence: Experimental sessions were conducted once every 1-2 weeks for 2 months per drug... received different doses at each session (within-subject across ~6-7 dose sessions)

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug HTR baseline data reported; vehicle controls used instead

assays.assay_description: 30-min recording of distance traveled (cm) in the same TruScan arena via photobeam tracking, following s.c. drug injection. Doses: DOI 0.03-10 mg/kg, LSD 0.003-1 mg/kg, psilocybin 0.03-10 mg/kg, in male and female mice.

setup_habituation.evidence: After 5 min of acclimation... followed by s.c. injection

setup_restrain.evidence: mice were returned to test chambers for 30 min (freely moving)

food_restriction.evidence: No food in apparatus during 30 min recording; ad libitum in home cage

water_restriction.evidence: No water in apparatus during 30 min recording; ad libitum in home cage

time_to_assay.evidence: mice were returned to test chambers for 30 min after injection

sample_size.evidence: Each drug was tested using groups of 12 mice per sex (i.e., 24 total mice per drug); same cohorts used for locomotor measurements (n = 5-7 per dose)

outcomes.summary: Locomotor effects were drug-specific: LSD decreased locomotion at 1 mg/kg; psilocybin produced mild increases at 0.3-1 mg/kg and decreased activity at 10 mg/kg; DOI had no significant locomotor effect. No sex differences were detected.
outcomes.statistics: No dose x sex interactions were observed for temperature or locomotor effects of the drugs (Table S4)
outcomes.evidence: LSD produced mild hypothermia and decreased locomotion at the highest dose tested (1 mg/kg)... Psilocybin administration produced mild increases in locomotor activity after doses of 0.3-1 mg/kg, but decreased locomotor activity at the highest dose of 10 mg/kg.

B1_num_measures.evidence: locomotor activity was quantified via photobeam tracking of distance traveled in cm

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Total distance over the session reported, no within-session time-course analysis described

B4_ethological.evidence: Locomotor distance is not an ethological behaviour per rubric

B7_automated_classification.evidence: photobeam tracking — position-tracking only (SCORE-0 per rubric)

D3_recording_days.evidence: Experimental sessions conducted once every 1-2 weeks for 2 months per drug; mice received different doses across sessions

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug locomotor baseline reported for this assay

judge_notes: Treated HTR and locomotor activity as two separate assays since they measure different behavioural domains (head twitch vs. spatial locomotion), even though recorded simultaneously in the same TruScan apparatus.
Excluded radioligand binding assays and body temperature measurements as non-behavioural (per rubric).
B1 scored 0 (single measure) for HTR — only HTR counts were analysed in this assay; temporal time-course of the same single measure does not add another measure but does trigger B2=Yes.

D1 scored 0 (Single session): although mice were tested across multiple dose sessions, each individual condition was recorded once; this is a within-subject dose-response design, not repeated sessions of the same condition.
Group housing scored 'no' because the paper explicitly states mice were single-housed post-transponder-implant and for the duration of experiments.
B7 scored 0: CleverSys (TopScan) and photobeam tracking are explicitly on the SCORE-0 list.
